summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Red Metal Resources Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the completion of LiDAR analysis and identification of new exploration targets at its Carrizal property in Chile. No corporate transactions (M&A, tender, capital return, restructuring) or forced management changes are disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update on exploration activities, per Regulation 13a-16. It does not constitute a special situation under the given categories.
